_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Facilities Requirements Data (FRD) Development for Typical Shore-Based and Shipboard Sites
summary: The Facilities Requirements Data (FRD) development process delineates facilities criteria and the proper capture and storage of data related to weapon systems, program office, and site facilities requirements.
use_relationship:
The Facilities Requirements Data (FRD) development process for typical shore-based and shipboard sites delineates facilities criteria and the proper capture/storage of data related to weapon systems, program office, RDT&E, training, operational, deployment site, maintenance, aviation ship integration (if applicable) and support equipment facilities requirements.
The FRD defines platform-specific criteria/data, independent of any current or planned facilities. Responses to FRD questions may be part of an iterative process as program technology matures and contractor responses to requirements are updated. All facilities requirements data within the FRD template/submittal shall be provided as a deliverable to the Government as prescribed within the appropriate CDRL.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement, as delineated in the contract.
Reference documents: The applicable issue of the document - including its approval date and dates of applicable revisions and changes-shall be as specified in the contract.
This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-81825C.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The FRD shall be presented in the template provided by the government in support of this task and subsequent contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The FRD shall contain the following information:

children.title: Item 1, Pre-Award Facilities Requirements Data.
children.content: Pre-award data identifies any major facilities requirements that should be considered during the material solution analysis process. The data is quantitative in nature and correlates to a common template of questions related to the weapon system. This includes, but is not limited to, platform/aircraft description, platform/aircraft handling Platform/aircraft servicing, and specifications.

children.title: Item 2, Post-Award Facilities Requirement Data.
children.content: Post-award data details the weapon system's requirements with respect to ship and shore facilities such as weight, dimensions, HAZMAT, environment, security, etc. Requirements Data correlates to the program-specific requirement questions/template, and it includes any tables and graphical illustrations that support the quantitative system dimensions.

children.title: Item 3, Appendices.
children.content: To include, but not limited to, list of Applicable Abbreviations and Acronyms, unique materials list, SE list, HAZMAT listing, and list of applicable publications.
